entities.name: Murder of Helena Jubany
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Helena Jubany Lorente was a 27-year-old librarian found dead in Sabadell, Catalonia, after being thrown from a terrace into an inner courtyard. She was discovered stripped naked, with several burns on her body.
